description.value: Líl̓wat Station is a Chevron gas station and convenience store operated by the Líl̓wat Nation's business arm, opened in 2019 in Mount Currie approximately 35 km north of Whistler. The well-stocked store carries grab-and-go food, snacks, and Líl̓wat branded merchandise, and also houses a Canada Post outlet — a useful combination for cyclists passing through on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. It serves Líl̓wat Nation citizens, neighbouring communities, and tourists alike.

address.value: 407 IR 10 Road, Líl̓wat Nation, Mount Currie, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Líl̓wat Station is an active, open convenience store with a Chevron gas station and Canada Post outlet in Mount Currie, opened in 2019 — supporting both the Groceries category and confirmed_open=true.
